当前游戏的显示选项在 ESP 页设置。: Adjust display options on the ESP tab.
叠加层只对齐本机前台游戏窗口，鼠标操作穿透；切走游戏后隐藏。适用于窗口化或无边框: The overlay follows the local foreground game window and lets mouse input pass through. It hides when the game loses focus. Use windowed or borderless mode.
截图策略仅对叠加层生效，由 Windows 请求排除捕获，效果取决于截图或录屏方: Capture policy applies only to the overlay. Windows capture exclusion depends on the capture method. Software rendering uses the CPU; Windows still composes the desktop.
